title: Surreal Portal Guardian
description: A woman in a white dress and chainmail mask stands beside a stone archway, her hand on a glowing red female silhouette emerging from a portal filled with floating faces. In the foreground, a green dog-like creature with a pink circular eye and white branching veins stands watch, while a vibrant fantasy landscape with a castle, lavender fields, and a small armored figure unfolds beyond.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene with a woman wearing a white dress and chainmail face mask standing at a cracked stone archway, her hand touching a glowing red female silhouette that emerges from a purple portal covered in floating face patterns. In the foreground is a green dog-like creature with a glowing pink circular eye and white vein-like branches growing from its body. Beyond the arch is a detailed landscape with purple lavender fields, a winding path, a small armored knight, mountains, and a distant castle under a pink and orange sky.
